files.justification: GATE 3 naming test: cluster A 'receipt-to-calendar-event parsing' (GmailReceiptsRequest, GmailScanResult, GmailReceiptsProcessor, GmailScanProducer, and the receipt-parsing regex/helpers) transforms Gmail receipt emails into calendar events; cluster B 'Gmail scanning/reporting' (GmailScanClassesRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, GmailMailListRequest/Result/Processor/Producer, GmailSweepTopRequest/Result/Processor/Producer) lists/aggregates Gmail metadata without producing calendar events. Neither cluster calls the other; both are independent Request/Processor/Producer pipelines against the same Gmail service but transform different data, no shared module-level mutable state.
GATE 4 default: line_count=253 < 350. Single responsibility: Outlook event removal pipeline (Request/PlanEntry/Result/Processor/Producer).

GATE 3 naming test: cluster A 'generic Outlook command runners' (_build_outlook_service and all run_outlook_* functions except run_outlook_scan_classes) execute pipeline-based commands directly; cluster B 'message-scan pipeline' (_scan_infer_meta, _scan_extract_from_message, _scan_enrich_items, _scan_dedup_events, OutlookScanRequest, OutlookScanResult, OutlookScanProcessor, OutlookScanProducer, run_outlook_scan_classes) is a self-contained SafeProcessor pipeline for extracting events from messages. Cluster A never calls cluster B's scan helpers/classes; cluster B's _scan_* helpers are only called by OutlookScanProcessor. No shared module-level mutable state. NOTE (orchestrator): cluster A REMAINS in the original file; proposed_siblings lists only the NEW file(s) to create.
GATE 4 default: line_count=241 < 350. Single responsibility: Outlook settings-sync pipeline.
